en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Fazaal, or someone else, from Jameel, from Aban, 
(It has been narrated) from Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘
He<sup>asws</sup> was asked about a man who bequeathed with ‘something’ from his wealth. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The ‘something’ in the Book of Ali<sup>asws</sup> is (one) from six (1/6)’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from ibn Faddal or others from Jamil from Aban who has narrated the following: “Ali ibn al-Husayn, ‘Alayhim al-Salam,
was asked about the case of a man who made a will about something of his legacy. He (the Imam) said, ‘According to the book of Ali, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, it is one-sixth.’”
